title: Trapping Rain Water II
description: Calculate the volume of water trapped after raining in a 3D elevation map represented by a 2D matrix.
pseudocode:
1. Initialize min-heap with boundary cells
2. Mark boundary cells as visited
3. While heap is not empty:
4. Pop cell with minimum height
5. For each neighbor:
6. If not visited, calculate trapped water
7. Push neighbor to heap with max(height, neighborHeight)
8. Mark neighbor as visited
